Bundles the newest core and gateway 0.16.28 with protocol 92. Provider setup edits retain each model’s saved reasoning choices, defaults, labels and context metadata unless reasoning is explicitly changed. Existing model selections remain selected when editing the model list. The native bridge and gateway now use the same protocol.

**Offline config upgrade required before using the bundled gateway with existing 0.16.27 data.** Gateway config is now 28; Bot state, checkpoint JSON and checkpoint SQLite remain at 8, 19 and 13. Stop all writers, retain verified backups and follow the [manual upgrade instructions](https://github.com/citizenhicks/mobius/blob/mobius-gateway-v0.16.28/scripts/README-portable-upgrade.md). Startup does not migrate old state. Use protocol-92 clients, including iOS 0.10.0 build 441.
